honda.content: Honda Civic: Base Price: $24,000 (Sedan LX) / $24,950 (Hatchback LX) Trims: LX, Sport, EX, EX-L, Sport Touring, Si, Type R Engine Options: - 2.0L 4-cylinder: 158 hp, 138 lb-ft torque (LX/Sport) - 1.5L turbocharged 4-cylinder: 192 hp, 192 lb-ft torque (EX and above) - Civic Si: 1.5L turbo, 200 hp, 6-speed manual only - Civic Type R: 2.0L VTEC Turbo, 315 hp, 6-speed manual, 0–60 in 5.4 sec

Transmission: CVT standard; 6-speed manual on Si and Type R Fuel Economy: Up to 36 mpg city / 46 mpg highway (1.5T CVT) Safety: Honda Sensing suite standard on all trims (CMBS, LKAS, ACC, RDM) Infotainment: 7-inch or 9-inch Honda CONNECT touchscreen, Apple CarPlay / Android Auto wireless Colors: Sonic Gray Pearl, Aegean Blue, Rallye Red, Lunar Silver, Crystal Black, Boost Blue (Type R)

Honda Financing & Service:
Honda Financial Services: Financing from 0.9% APR (well-qualified buyers), lease options available
Honda Care (Extended Warranty): Available up to 8 years / 120,000 miles
Maintenance Minder: Oil life monitoring system, standard on all models
Roadside Assistance: 3-year / 36,000-mile roadside assistance included with new vehicle purchase

tesla.content: Tesla Model S Base Price: $74,990 Variant: Model S Long Range — up to 405 miles EPA range Variant: Model S Plaid — up to 396 miles, 0–60 mph in 1.99 seconds, 1,020 hp Top Speed: 155 mph (Long Range) / 200 mph (Plaid with Track Package) Charging: Supercharger V3 up to 250kW, 15 min for 200 miles Display: 17-inch horizontal cinematic touchscreen, 12.3-inch front passenger display

Autopilot: Standard Autopilot included; Full Self-Driving (FSD) available ($8,000 or $99/month) Interior: 5-seat or 7-seat configuration (optional) Colors: Pearl White, Midnight Silver, Deep Blue, Red Multi-Coat, Stealth Grey, Ultra Red Warranty: 4-year/50,000-mile basic, 8-year/150,000-mile battery and drive unit

Full Self-Driving (FSD) Capability
Price: $8,000 one-time or $99/month subscription
Features: Navigate on Autopilot, Auto Lane Change, Auto Park, Summon, Traffic Light and Stop Sign Control, Autosteer on city streets
Note: Requires driver supervision; not fully autonomous

Tesla Charging Solutions
Home Wall Connector: $400 + installation, up to 44 miles per hour of charge
Supercharger Network: 50,000+ Superchargers globally, pay per kWh
Mobile Connector: Included with new vehicles, J1772 adapter included
